newsitem.title: UK: TREG has slim uptake on KEPIT offer.
newsitem.headline: TREG has slim uptake on KEPIT offer.

text.p: TR European Growth Trust Plc (TREG) said it had received acceptances equivalent to 2.8 percent of Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc (KEPIT) ordinary shares and to 2.3 percent of issued warrants.
It said the offer, which it has extended to October 4, had gained these acceptance levels by 1400 GMT on September 13.
TREG is offering 103.1 pence for shares and warrants if holders opt for cash, or the equivalent of 107.6 pence if they chose to take TR European shares.
But KEPIT is challenging the deal TR European can get for the shares and has pointed out that it can offer an extra 10 million stg in cost savings.
"We are obviously pleased that thousands of KEPIT shareholders and warrantholders have accepted the TREG offers," Sir Geoffrey Littler, chairman of TREG, said in a statement.
